integrity: Universal upper bounds proved by marked-star induction, matching finite lower trees are complete and separately replayed, and small-order exact minimax recurrences corroborate. No independent mathematical or global priority audit.
limitations: Only strict disjointness of unordered pairs as hypotheses against unordered triples as adaptive queries, at finite ground-set orders n>=3; no claims for other ranks, static VC dimension, randomized regret, or communication complexity.
title: Exact Littlestone dimension of pair–triple disjointness
